title: Biblia de Ferrara — Amsterdam 5406/1646 Source Facsimile

sourceBasis.historicalRelation: The first Biblia de Ferrara was printed in Ferrara in 1553 for Spanish-speaking Sephardic readers and is associated in the linked study with Abraham Usque and Yom-Tob Atias. The preserved consultation facsimile is an Amsterdam edition dated Hebrew year 5406 / 1646 within the Ferrara textual tradition.
sourceBasis.sourcePreservation: The facsimile remains separate from the modern numerical study. Historical spelling and typography are retained as source evidence; OCR artifacts are not silently promoted to normalized source text.

sourceFaithfulLines: Traduzida palabra por palabra de la verdad Hebrayca,
titlePageWitness.note: These lines preserve historically significant spelling from the facsimile witness. The analytical study uses a separately declared normalization profile for calculation.
